Cleaning a fish tank doesn't always mean draining it. In this method, waste and debris are removed while the water stays in place. Tools like siphon vacuums and filtration systems pull out uneaten food, algae, and sediment from the gravel, keeping the environment clean without stressing the fish. What makes this approach effective is balance. Beneficial bacteria remain undisturbed, water chemistry stays stable, and the tank continues to cycle naturally. It's a low-impact way to maintain a healthy aquarium, showing how smart maintenance can work with the ecosystem instead of resetting it. This video is for educational purposes only. I’ll take my tank cleeean 🧼  Same routine different week. People always ask me why I post the same weekly water change every #waterchangewednesday 💦  -why not? Maybe it’s motivation to some people who lack water changes. Maybe it shows others new tricks. Maybe it helps others understand the process?  Step 1: Grab some tank water and mix @Seachem cichlid lake salt and malawi/victoria buffer. (Only add for the amount of gallons you’re taking out) Step 2: Start draining the tank and using your python to suck up loose poop behind/under the rocks. Doesn’t matter how many wavemakers or filters you have.. It’s there.. just move some decor and you’ll find it.  -this only applies for my cichlid tank. I leave the poop in my planted tanks 🌿 Step 3: Clean my aquarium glass using @Flipper Aquarium Products Max flipper edge 🧼  Step 4: Start filling up the tank and dose @MicrobeLift Xtreme to make my tap water safe & fish protector to reduce stress -which also promotes any healing with the power of aloe Vera 🌱 Step 5: Add in the salt & buffer mixture once the tank is almost filled up (don’t forget to stir it continuously while doing your maintenance)  Don’t forget to turn your heaters and filters off if you’re draining your tank low! This prevents any accidentals that could occur. Fish equipment isn’t cheap, so take care of it 🤙🏼 Have a blessed week everyone 😁 #fluvalaquatics #microbelift #malawicichlids #africancichlids

“Seu aquário fica turvo poucos dias depois da limpeza? O erro pode estar aqui.” Limpe seu aquário em 10 minutos por semana sem estressar seus peixes nem quebrar o ecossistema. Se você esvazia o aquário todo domingo achando que tá cuidando bem, calma. É justamente isso que deixa a água turva de novo em 2 dias e some com os peixes aos poucos. Troque só 20% da água, nunca tudo. Passe o sifão no fundo pra tirar sujeira e restos de ração. Limpe o vidro por dentro com os peixes lá mesmo, sem susto.
